punchline: Frankl lost his manuscript at Auschwitz and began rebuilding it on scraps of paper.
thirty_sec: In October 1944 Viktor Frankl arrived at Auschwitz, and the draft of his first book, hidden in his coat lining, was lost. He began rebuilding it from memory on slips of paper and later credited that decision, among other things, with his survival.
question: What unfinished piece of your own work could you add one line to this week, whatever else is happening?
key_contrast: In a hard stretch, keep a task of your own that points to the future.
